name: mcp__robot__act
mcp__robot__close_in_place
description:
Calculate one full dual-arm TCP target from the latest measured state. Keep both poses and the other gripper unchanged; set the selected arm's opening (default 0, fully closed). Read-only; does not close or verify grasp. Returns control_step, computed_only and targets; inspect them, then call act with targets. Recalculate after any intervening action.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__robot__close_in_place(args: { arm: "left" | "right"; opening?: number; }): Promise<CallToolResult>; };
```

name: mcp__robot__hold_current
description:
Calculate one full dual-arm TCP target from the latest measured state, preserving both poses and gripper openings. Read-only: no motion, VLA call, physics step or proposal replacement. Returns control_step, computed_only and targets; inspect them, then call act with targets to execute. Recalculate after any intervening action.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__robot__hold_current(args: {  }): Promise<CallToolResult>; };
```

name: mcp__robot__move_relative
description:
Calculate one full dual-arm TCP target from the latest measured state. Add delta_m to the selected arm's TCP XYZ in environment axes; preserve both orientations, gripper openings and the other arm. Read-only; no motion or collision planning. Returns control_step, computed_only and targets; inspect them, then call act with targets. Recalculate after any intervening action.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__robot__move_relative(args: { arm: "left" | "right"; delta_m: Array<number>; }): Promise<CallToolResult>; };
```

name: mcp__robot__observe
description:
Read current RGB, measured TCP positions, pitch/roll/yaw degrees relative to the downward reference, permissions and budgets without advancing physics. Display floats use at most three decimal places.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__robot__observe(args: {  }): Promise<CallToolResult>; };
```

name: mcp__robot__vla_propose
description:
Predict without moving. Give one short English immediate action naming the observed object and destination when needed; omit reasoning, code and multi-step plans. Return proposal_id and preview at steps 5,10,15,20,25,30,35,40,45,50 only. Each arm has pos_m (TCP XYZ), angles_deg ([pitch about +X, roll about +Y, yaw about +Z] from downward), grip (0 closed, 1 open), and measured-start prefix diagnostics: delta_cm, path_cm, max_step_cm, max_rotation_step_deg, max_joint_step_rad, grip_delta and grip_range (including start). Row bounds are cumulative existing warnings through that step. Statistics include every original step in the prefix. Read with RGB; predictions do not establish grasp or safety. No full 50-point inspection. A new proposal replaces the old one; act uses its stored original joint prefix.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__robot__vla_propose(args: { subgoal: string; }): Promise<CallToolResult>; };
```
